ns2:section.sectionText: This course offers students an opportunity to explore the art of theatrical performance on multiple levels, from the role of the audience, to the preparation of the actor, director and designers. Students will meet and discuss the various jobs behind the scenes with professionals and practitioners of the art. They will also have a chance to see up close the art of the theatre at the Krannert Center for the Performing Arts in several special tours behind the scenes with experts and artists as well as viewing plays in performance.
